what_constrained: One 16-design PBW across rectangular, round, color, and monochrome targets; shared QEMU retained another active face and one screenshot was partial.
what_worked: C primitive motifs kept binary and RAM use low; explicit active-face selection and native captures exposed round overlap and small-screen phrase clipping before delivery.
what_differently: Treat each emulator screenshot as valid only after confirming the active face and a complete redraw; inspect the smallest and round targets earlier.

what_constrained: The first native contact sheet met functional checks but lost the concept art's visual density; a Gabbro bitmap then tiled because its actual screen was 260 by 260.
what_worked: A screen-only art atlas preserved illustrated motifs while live C-rendered numerals kept the watchface functional; a production 16-face native sheet and platform spot checks exposed layout faults.
what_differently: Make a native visual fidelity gate explicit before calling a concept-driven face done; verify the actual target resolution before preparing bitmap resources.

what_constrained: The 64-color palette could not express the concept's muted sage as a single flat color; ordered dithering made the native Paper Garden screen noisy.
what_worked: Focused before/after native captures and fresh visual review preserved the successful round Station House and Margin Notes changes while rejecting the color regression.
what_differently: Judge palette experiments at native watch size before rebuilding the full package; keep a calm field when a closer numeric color damages the composition.

what_constrained: Removing a persisted battery setting could shift later preferences on existing installations if its enum slot were deleted.
what_worked: Explicit storage IDs retired battery slot 4 while keeping other keys stable; shared renderer removal, clean build, and native captures verified battery absence.
what_differently: Assign explicit IDs to persisted settings from the first implementation so feature removal cannot silently migrate unrelated preferences.

what_constrained: Ledger's default view hid that its shared optional date mask erased calendar rows, while Margin Notes' solid cream trial changed the paper tone too strongly.
what_worked: Native captures with ISO date exposed the collision; a header date placement preserved the grid, and a sparse warm paper treatment kept Margin Notes restrained. Independent review checked the final captures.
what_differently: For concept fidelity, capture nondefault display settings that can touch decorative structure before declaring a composition finished.
